# Which group sessions should you run this term, and who sits in which?

> Free group schedule optimizer for tutoring centres, music, swim and language schools. Paste your possible weekly sessions and student availability to get the most profitable timetable. Exact for up to 10 slots. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
